paper.title_en: Deformed Schwarzschild horizons in second-order perturbation theory: mass, geometry, and teleology
paper.abstract_en: In recent years, gravitational-wave astronomy has motivated increasingly accurate perturbative studies of gravitational dynamics in compact binaries. This in turn has enabled more detailed analyses of the dynamical black holes in these systems. For example, Pound et al. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 124, 021101 (2020)] recently computed the surface area of a Schwarzschild black hole's apparent horizon, perturbed by an orbiting body, to second order in the binary's mass ratio. In this paper, we take that as the starting point for a comprehensive study of a perturbed Schwarzschild black hole's apparent and event horizon at second perturbative order, deriving generic formulas for the first- and second-order corrections to the horizons' radial profiles, surface areas, Hawking masses, and intrinsic curvatures. We find that the two horizons are remarkably similar, and that any teleological behavior of the event horizon is suppressed in several ways. Critically, we establish that at all orders, the perturbed event horizon in a small-mass-ratio binary is effectively localized in time. Even more pointedly, the event horizon is identical to the apparent horizon at linear order regardless of the source of perturbation, implying that the seemingly teleological "tidal lead", previously observed in linearly perturbed event horizons, is not genuinely teleological in origin. The two horizons do generically differ at second order, but their Hawking masses remain identical, implying that the event horizon obeys the same energy-flux balance law as the apparent horizon. At least in the case of a binary system, the difference between their surface areas remains extremely small even in the late stages of inspiral. In the course of our analysis, we also numerically illustrate puzzling behaviour in the black hole's motion around the binary's center of mass.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文对微扰史瓦西黑洞的表观视界和事件视界进行了全面且严谨的二阶微扰研究，推导了通用公式，揭示了重要性质，如事件视界的局部化行为和与表观视界的异同。内容深入，方法严谨，适合广义相对论基础领域的研究者阅读。
decision.title_zh: 二阶微扰理论中的变形史瓦西视界：质量、几何与目的论
decision.abstract_zh: 近年来，引力波天文学推动了对致密双星中引力动力学日益精确的微扰研究。这进而使得对这些系统中动力学的黑洞进行更详细的分析成为可能。例如，Pound等人[Phys. Rev. Lett. 124, 021101 (2020)]最近计算了受绕行天体微扰的史瓦西黑洞表观视界的表面积，达到双星质量比的二阶。在本文中，我们以此为基础，对微扰史瓦西黑洞的二阶表观视界和事件视界进行全面的研究，推导了一阶和二阶修正下视界的径向轮廓、表面积、霍金质量和内禀曲率的通用公式。我们发现这两个视界非常相似，并且事件视界的任何目的论行为在多个方面受到抑制。关键的是，我们建立了一个结论：在所有阶次下，小质量比双星中的微扰事件视界在时间上是局部化的。更尖锐地说，无论微扰源是什么，事件视界在线性阶与表观视界相同，这意味着先前在线性微扰事件视界中观察到的看似目的论的“潮汐领先”并非真正源于目的论。这两个视界在二阶确实普遍不同，但它们的霍金质量仍然相同，这意味着事件视界遵循与表观视界相同的能量通量平衡律。至少在双星系统的情况下，即使在旋进的后期，它们的表面积差异仍然非常小。在我们的分析过程中，我们还数值演示了黑洞在双星质心周围运动中的令人费解的行为。
